sub_site: hepatocellular carcinoma FFPE tissue (16 tumour, 7 adjacent non-tumour)

evidence.quote: In total, 23 FFPE blocks (16 tumor tissues and 7 nontumor tissues) were prepared from tumor tissues collected at baseline.
The V1-V2 region of the bacterial 16 S rRNA gene was amplified via PCR

controls.types: paraffin-only blanks per recruitment centre; extraction reagent blanks

evidence.quote: As negative controls, paraffin-only samples prepared at each recruitment center were used, as were all the reagents used for DNA extraction.
the count table for all 26 samples (including the negative controls with paraffin and reagents) was obtained
Sequences detected in the negative controls, independent of their relative abundances, were excluded from downstream analysis.
Whether an ASV was not previously described as inhabiting the human gut [ 30 ], it was considered an external contaminant

notes: Only 20 of 66 patients gave PCR product. Control-detected sequences removed, then 471/997 ASVs discarded as paraffin/environment/skin origin by habitat annotation (literature-based) and co-occurrence degree <=5 filter. Full genus list (66 genera) in SF3 supplement, not available. Acinetobacter (lwoffii) flagged as contaminant only in Discussion.
